title: ToolInvocationResulted
description: Emitted by a tool worker after completing a ToolInvocationRequested. Topic: conversation-events.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at the time the event was produced.

eventType.description: Discriminator field identifying the event type.

toolName.description: Name of the tool that produced this result. Must match the toolName from the corresponding ToolInvocationRequested.

result.description: Tool output as a free-form key-value map. Consumers should not assume a fixed shape.
